name: agentsvc.io

overview.text: AgentSvc presents 127 paid JSON services across web retrieval, AI extraction, company checks, agent memory/inboxes and financial data. Operational counts and 99.8% seven-day self-test pass rate are operator measurements, not independent paid-call checks. Free trials use example input rather than arbitrary customer input, limited to three calls/service/day, one for heavy services and 20/IP overall. No-account x402 is separate from prepaid API-key credits and webhook watches that charge credits for each check. USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum is documented, the latter two requiring x402 v2; an older error explanation still says Base only. Homepage starting-price and illustrated scrape-price examples differ, so route quotes govern. Default responses can say settling before background settlement; synchronous mode waits for the receipt. HTTP 200 or pending payment fields do not prove final settlement or client delivery. Uncharged-failure promises are operator claims. Company, token and security assessments are not legal clearance or safe-investment guarantees.

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (20:24-20:59 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with agentsvc.io or YourAITools is involved.
